items.proposed: no selection biomarker; MGMT row role exploratory_correlative (not eligibility)
items.reason: Eligibility only requires "Enough tumor tissue available for determination of MGMT gene promoter status"; no MGMT status is required for entry, so it is not an entry requirement (status only modifies TMZ cycles).

R4 names Td toxoid given to support a vaccine as part of the excluded therapy; the record says Td "may help improve the effectiveness of the DC vaccine", i.e. a vaccine-site adjuvant, not a delivery-enabling drug. The R4 exception is arguable because Gr1 vs Gr2 compares Td pre-conditioning with OS as primary outcome, but the hypothesis is DC-vaccine enhancement, not an antitumour effect of Td itself. D31-B8 (extension of D30-R4) settles this: Td is given to support the DC vaccine ("may help improve the effectiveness of the DC vaccine"), so it is part of the excluded therapy.
No tumour biomarker is required for entry or for an arm; MGMT testing tissue availability is not an MGMT status requirement.

note: Td toxoid settled by D31-B8 (vaccine-support drug, excluded_intervention_type); varlilumab remains the only candidate. MGMT tissue-availability criterion is testing, not selection (consistent with D31-A8). Nothing pending for XL.
